info.name: DeliGo Ride-Sharing API
info.description:
DeliGo Ride-Sharing API Postman collection reconciled against mounted Express routes, controllers, and validation schemas.

BASE URLS
baseUrl includes the API prefix and defaults to http://localhost:3000/api/v1 (PORT defaults to 3000). Set it in a local Postman environment for deployment. serverUrl is the origin used by GET /health.

AUTHENTICATION
Collection authentication uses Bearer accessToken; protected requests override it with driverAccessToken, fleetAccessToken, or adminAccessToken where appropriate. Public requests and optional-auth logout disable inherited auth. Authentication header: Authorization: Bearer <token>. Auth calls send x-client-platform: mobile so refreshToken is returned in JSON in addition to the httpOnly cookie scoped to /api/v1/auth. Route roles are listed in each request implementation snapshot.

RESPONSE CONTRACT
Successful JSON handlers using sendResponse return success, statusCode, and message, with data and/or pagination meta when supplied by the controller. Errors return success:false, statusCode, message, code, and errorSources (plus stack in development). Validation failures are 422; authentication/authorization failures are 401/403 where applicable. Analytics export returns text/csv. No static response fixtures are included because runtime data is database- and environment-dependent.

VARIABLES AND WORKFLOWS
Successful authentication responses populate accessToken, role-specific tokens, refreshToken when present, and userId. Signup initiation captures signupSessionId. Fare estimate captures estimatedFare for the follow-up ride request. Creation responses capture IDs for follow-up calls. The create-admin response does not return the invitation token: copy it from the invitation email URL into adminInviteToken. Configure blank email/password/contact/provider variables locally; never commit production credentials or tokens.

UPLOADS
Uploads require authentication. Single upload uses multipart field file; multiple upload uses files (up to 10). Allowed MIME types are JPEG/JPG, PNG, WEBP, and PDF; max 10 MB per file. Let Postman generate multipart boundaries. Use URLs returned by upload for KYC and vehicle-photo requests.

SOCKET.IO
Connect with a valid access token in auth.token or the Authorization handshake header and an active session. Client events: join_ride({rideId}), notification_subscribe, driver_location_update({lat,lng,heading?,speed?}), message({message}). Server events: room_joined, live_location, new_chat_message, notification, sos_alert, ride_status_updated, error. Ride-room access is limited to ride participants or admins.
